relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: confirming that the drug significantly inhibits the firing frequency of action potentials in nociceptive neurons without significant impact on the cardiac isoform Nav1.5 and central isoforms Nav1.1/1.2

relationships.subject: SNHG5
relationships.evidence_quote: the long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) SNHG5 recruits CDK9 to the SCN9A promoter to increase Nav1.7 expression

relationships.subject: SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein
relationships.evidence_quote: Liu et al14 revealed that the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein directly interacts with Nav1.7 to enhance sodium currents

relationships.subject: histone methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Yeh et al showed that histone methylation modifications induce TRPV1 upregulation directly at the transcriptional level in paclitaxel-induced Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN)

relationships.subject: estrogen
relationships.evidence_quote: Artero-Morales et al21 demonstrated that estrogen can upregulate TRPV1 expression and function

relationships.subject: HDAC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Zhang et al33 observed that in bone cancer pain, the EREG/EGFR-ERK-Runx1 axis silences KCNQ2/KCNQ3 expression via HDAC2

key_findings: Review proposes a DRG-centered Hierarchical Regulation Model: acute ion-channel remodeling (Nav1.7/1.8, TRP), intermediate neuro-glial-immune signaling, and long-term epigenetic consolidation.
Suzetrigine validated in human DRG neurons supports a human-first drug development paradigm.
